name: Mannan Koothu
description: A ritual performance of the Mannan people of Idukki, retelling the story of Kannaki and Kovalan from the Silappathikaram. It is staged at night, and Kovilmalakkudi is named as the seat of the Mannan tribe.

name: Gadhika
description: A ritual art of the Adiya community of Wayanad, performed to cure illness and ward off the evil eye. It comes in two forms, Naattu Gadhika and Pooja Gadhika.

name: Vattakali
description: A circular dance of the Paniya community, listed by Kerala Tourism among Wayanad's major tribal art forms.

name: Nellukuthu Pattu
description: A paddy-pounding song tradition of the Kurichiya community, listed by Kerala Tourism among Wayanad's tribal arts.

name: Kadammanitta Padayani
description: A major Padayani festival at the Kadammanitta Bhagavathy Temple. Kerala Tourism lists Kadammanitta, Kottangal, Othara and Kunnanthaanam in Pathanamthitta as the main Padayani villages.

name: Ettumanoor Ezhara Ponnana
description: A ritual at the Ettumanoor Mahadeva Temple in which eight-and-a-half golden elephants, offered to Shiva, are displayed.

name: Pothichoru
description: A meal of rice and curries wrapped in a banana leaf, a traditional way of packing food that restaurant listings in Pathanamthitta and Thiruvalla still feature.

name: Kori Rotti
description: A Tulu dish of crisp rice wafers served with a coconut-based chicken curry ('kori' means chicken in Tulu). One guide names it the trademark dish of Uppala, north of Kasaragod.

name: Patholi
description: Sweet rice dumplings filled with jaggery and coconut and steamed in turmeric leaves, a coastal dish of the Kasaragod–Mangalore belt.

name: Beary biryani
description: A biryani that is a specialty of the Beary community, described as a cousin of the Mangalorean biryani.
